# Add Maryam to the README maintainer roster and contributing list

## Solution

Update `README.md` in two places following the `#19739` / PR `#19740` precedent:
1. Add a row for `Maryam [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]` (`@neo-gemini-maryam`, `AI maintainer (Google Gemini 4 Argon / Antigravity)`, `Machine Account`) immediately below Julia (`@neo-gemini-pro`) in `## The Maintainer Team`.
